title: Machine learning prediction and calibration of cellulose-based solid-phase extraction performance for pharmaceuticals across aqueous matrices
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,12475-12501
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09776B, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ephriam Akor, Damilare Olorunnisola, Moses O. Alfred, Onome Ejeromedoghene, Martins O. Omorogie
Cellulose-based solid-phase extraction has been proposed for concentrating trace pharmaceuticals from complex waters; however, cross-laboratory transfer remains uncertain because studies vary in matrix chemistry, sorbent functionalization, extraction format and elution strategy.
